note: Zone of the B25 map room (R_abs_space_01): the round white town-plan alcove at the far end, under a glass skylight dome, with a huge town plan painted on the floor and little model houses; camera inside the alcove facing back. All six words are masculine (right of the offset divider). Girl pushing a red pin into one place on the plan (lieu); boy pointing his sticks at a chalk-circled spot (endroit); donkey pulling a cart of model houses into a new neighbourhood (quartier); little white ghost popping up at the far end of a street (bout); three gingerbread men guarding the gate of a walled garden estate (domaine); removal man pushing a model house along on a trolley (mouvement). Exit: white arch on the left -> back to the map room R_abs_space_01. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
